en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a formal social gathering or dinner. Four well‑dressed adults are interacting around a table. A seated woman holding a flower or small plant smiles up at a standing man in a suit who is leaning toward her and returning the gesture. Another seated man in a suit looks on, while a woman standing in the background also holds a small plant or bouquet. Shelves with stacked dishes or cups can be seen behind them, suggesting a restaurant or event venue.
